## 2. What to build

**§10 Presence, statuses and Focus** (prototype frames 4, 8)
- **Green means one thing: reachable now** (Moduo open, not idle, not on do not disturb). Everything else is a grey shape: an **outline** for away (after 10 minutes idle; no "since" time, CH48), a **thick bar** for do not disturb (by hand, sick, vacation), a **target mark** for Focusing, **nothing** for offline. Presence shows where you'd message someone (direct-message rows, the person card on hover anywhere, the people in Details) and on Home, never in the top bar. "Show me as online" is a personal switch, on by default.
- **Focusing:** teammates see "Focusing" (plus "until 3:00 PM" only during a Pomodoro phase or a counted-down estimate, CH42); the task's title only if you turn on "Show what I'm focusing on" and they can see that task (CH47). Focus holds chat's pings until the session ends, then they arrive together: "3 messages while you focused".
- **Statuses** (CH28d, CH45): an emoji + short text + "clear after" (30 min · 1 h · today · this week · a date · never) + optionally "do not disturb while it's on"; Moduo's presets In a meeting · Out sick · On vacation · Commuting, and your own saved ones ("Sleeping until 6"); **one status for all your workspaces**; set from your avatar in the top bar. It shows in the direct message's header, on a line above the box ("Jana is on vacation until Oct 20. She won't be notified; your message waits in her Catch up"), the person card and Details' people; Chat adds it to the shared person picker, so Tasks' assign picker shows "Jana · on vacation until Oct 20" (BUILD_ORDER 🟠 box). During your quiet hours, teammates who message you see "Sofia's quiet hours · back 9:00" on the same line above the box (CH7).
- **Home:** Chat supplies each person's "now" line (Active · Focusing · Away · the status) to the one **Team** widget, above Tasks' load rows (CH70); **Catch up** is Chat's own widget (CH35).

**§15 Settings, and where each thing lives**
- **Your avatar (top bar):** your status and saved statuses · Do not disturb.

**§18 Calls: the seams Chat leaves**
- **the presence shapes** (§10) are one component that takes a sixth state, "In a call";

**Edge cases this block handles** (§Edge cases)
- A person in two workspaces with chat → statuses, quiet hours and do not disturb apply to both; the switcher counts each; the dock badge is the sum.

## 3. Acceptance criteria

**AC11 — Presence, statuses and Focus**
- **AC11.1** green = reachable, outline = away without a time, bar = do not disturb, target = focusing, nothing = offline
- **AC11.2** "Show me as online" off hides you
- **AC11.3** "Focusing" shows to teammates, "until" only with a Pomodoro phase or an estimate, the task title only with the opt-in and only to people who can see the task
- **AC11.4** statuses with presets, your own saved ones and "clear after", one for every workspace, shown wherever you'd message the person and on the line above the box

**AC6 — An agency's week (internal chat)**
- **AC6.6** the time a client was "Out sick" shows on their person card and holds pings.

**Tests that prove them** (file · name · AC · plain English)

- `supabase/tests/chat_statuses.test.sql` · "statuses, saved statuses, chat_now" · proves AC11.1, AC11.3, AC11.4, AC6.6 · One status for every workspace; presets and saved ones; expiry clears it; `chat_now` shows "Focusing", "until" only with a phase or an estimate, the task only with the opt-in and visibility; a do-not-disturb status holds pings.
- `src/features/chat/presence.test.ts` · "Show me as online" · proves AC11.2 · With the switch off the client never tracks itself on the presence topic and shows itself as offline to others; on, it tracks while the app is open and not idle.
- `tests/visual/chat-presence.spec.ts` · "the five shapes" · proves AC11.1 · Green dot, outline, thick bar, target, nothing: on dark and light, three densities, 3:1 contrast.

## 4. Decisions that bind it

- **Statuses** (round-3 §2.11, #20): `user_statuses`, one per person **for every workspace** (`user_id, emoji ≤ 16, text ≤ 100, dnd, clear_at, preset, set_at, updated_at`; null `clear_at` = never; `preset` closed: `meeting`, `sick`, `vacation`, `commuting`, null for your own); RLS lets anyone who shares a workspace read the row; published. Do not disturb by hand is a status with `dnd = true` and no text. `user_saved_statuses` (≤ 20, private: `id, user_id, emoji, text, dnd, clear_after, position, created_at`; `clear_after` closed: `30m`, `1h`, `today`, `this_week`, `date`, `never`). Presets live in `@contracts`, not rows: add `STATUS_PRESETS`, `STATUS_CLEAR_AFTER` (+ CHECKs). Ops `user_op_set_status(patch)`, `user_op_clear_status()`, `user_op_save_status(patch, id?)`, `user_op_forget_status(id)`; a job every 5 minutes (`user-statuses-expire`, index `(clear_at) where clear_at is not null`) clears expired statuses so the change travels live.
- **`chat_now(ws)`** (§2.13, the one read teammates get; never exposes the run): per member `status`, `dnd`, `focusing` (a running Focus run seen in the last 3 minutes **in any workspace**, from TV-F6's `focus_runs`, `20261013130000_focus_runs_v3`), `focus_until` (only a Pomodoro phase's end or a counted-down estimate's end, else null), `focus_task_id` (only with `user_preferences.show_focus_task` **and** the task in this workspace **and** `tasks__visible` for the caller). The caller must be a member; former members aren't listed. `quiet_now` / `back_at` arrive with CV-18.
- **Presence** (#17, #20): transport is CV-3's (`chat:<ws>`, display only); "Show me as online" (`show_online`, a client-honoured preference from CV-6a) means the client never tracks itself when off; away after 10 minutes idle with no time (CH48); reachable · away · offline are client-derived, never stored. A refused join shows "Presence isn't available".
- **The shapes:** green = reachable now, outline = away, thick bar = do not disturb, target = Focusing, nothing = offline; one component (the avatar's neutral badge, `src/components/ui/avatar.tsx`) that takes a sixth state "In a call" (§18) with text equivalents; 3:1 contrast, dark and light, three densities.
- **Where it shows** (§10): direct-message rows and header, the person card on hover anywhere, Details' people, Home (CV-22); the line above the box (#33): "Jana is on vacation until Oct 20. She won't be notified; your message waits in her Catch up."; the status picker from your avatar in the top bar (`src/components/app/app-chrome.tsx`): emoji, text, clear after, "do not disturb while it's on", presets, your saved ones; and the shared person picker, so Tasks' assign picker reads "Jana · on vacation until Oct 20" (`src/features/tasks/assignee-options.ts`, `src/features/spine/ui/mention-picker.tsx`).
- **Erasure and export** (#31): both tables go with the account (cascade from `profiles`; the preview counts them in `account_erase_workspace_data`, live body); the export carries your own saved statuses (`src/features/settings/advanced.ts`, `buildExportBundle`; conversations are CV-22's).

## 7. Watch out

- `chat_now` must not leak: test that the task shows only with the opt-in and visibility, and a non-member gets nothing.
- **Tier 2** (migrations, RLS, contracts, moduo-mcp, src/lib/runtime*): one `/code-review high` and one security scan of the diff at the end; scan findings go only into the hand-back.
- **Migration:** stamp provisional (re-cut on apply day, chat's order kept); redefine from live bodies (`pg_get_functiondef`); re-state grants by name (`DROP` + `CREATE` resets them); re-assert the Realtime publication if you publish a table; apply only on your migration turn, then `bun run db:test chat`; never `local:reset` or `migration up` (runbook, `docs/gotchas/supabase.md`).
- **Hot files:** `src/features/chat/store/*` (the presence slice). Keep edits there small; another builder may change them too.
- **Public repo:** describe no security weakness in any file; tell the orchestrator in the hand-back.

## 8. Out of scope for this block

Quiet hours, pausing, holds and the quiet-hours line (CV-18); the Team widget's "now" rows (CV-22); the "In a call" value itself (Calls).
